finalText:
Common cause: pass new object/array/function literal as prop each render. Same content, new reference — React `===` check fail, child re-render.

Fixes:
- Wrap inline objects/arrays: `useMemo(() => ({...}), [deps])`
- Wrap inline functions: `useCallback(fn, [deps])`
- Wrap child itself: `React.memo(ChildComponent)` — skip re-render when props shallow-equal.

Note: `React.memo` alone not enough if parent still pass new refs each time. Need both memo on child AND stable refs from parent.

Other cause: parent re-render trigger from context change, key change, or no memo at all (default: child always re-render when parent render, regardless of props).
